hypothesis: Exact game fingerprint linkage covers only 2700 of 4868 main games, while the recovered anonymous-pitcher to TrackMan-pitcher mapping covers about 99.8% of main rows and is injective. Reusing only history-derived high-purity identity mappings can expose the remaining official TrackMan pitches as target-free repertoire counts and improve the deployable fine-pitch selector.

selection_protocol.route: R matched rows for pitch-label diagnostics only
selection_protocol.identity_mapping_cutoff: joined games with season strictly before the prediction year
selection_protocol.trackman_profile_cutoff: all official TrackMan rows with season strictly before the prediction year and a history-mapped pitcher
selection_protocol.ranking: minimize worst selector log-loss, then mean log-loss, then maximize minimum top-1 improvement, then lexical candidate id
selection_protocol.on_fail: Close without reading any 2022+ control or selector metric.
selection_protocol.on_pass: Lock the selector recipe before integrating it into a separately preregistered control model.
